markdown:
a whippet in the senior chapter is not a generic dog. for this whippet, adult weight lands around 25-40 lb (11-18 kg), lifespan is typically 12-15 years, and day-to-day temperament looks like this: quiet house dog, explosive athlete outdoors. this whippet senior guide focuses on mobility, thirst, appetite trends, and tighter loops around heart screening needs. what normal looks like for a senior whippet

senior timing for a whippet often starts earlier in the medium class than in toy companions. for this whippet, use mobility, sleep, and thirst, not only birthday candles. pain is not a personality upgrade in an older whippet. for this whippet, video the gait every ninety days on the same floor. night pacing, potty accidents, and disorientation in a senior whippet are cognitive data points, not "just old."

medication logs beat memory once a whippet is on more than one daily drug. for this whippet, coat care still matters because mats and moisture hide sores: short coat; cold weather coats help. for this whippet, shorten the review interval when heart screening needs or dental disease is active, and keep lab pdfs beside the weight curve. breed-linked issues to watch in this stage

in a senior whippet, heart screening needs deserves shorter review loops because aging amplifies downtime. for this whippet, escalation cues for heart screening needs are on /symptoms/difficulty-breathing-dog. in a senior whippet, dental disease deserves shorter review loops because aging amplifies downtime. for this whippet, red flags belong on /symptoms/dental-pain-dog before a forum thread. practical context for this whippet

temperament shapes senior-stage risk management for a whippet: quiet house dog, explosive athlete outdoors. for this whippet, copied exercise advice from another breed fails this medium animal in the senior chapter. lifespan expectations around 12-15 years change how early a whippet household starts screening talks for heart screening needs during senior care. for this whippet, photograph certificates the day they are issued for this senior packet. home-monitoring checklist

faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Whippet?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 25-40 lb (11-18 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a senior Whippet?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Heart screening needs; Dental disease. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Whippet at this stage?
faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior Whippet, sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
